# sngl:macro is macro-only: it has no lib/platforms directory, only the
# per-target packages under it. It resolves against the macro registry, and
# unlike sngl:internal/marks it is public, so an ordinary program — or an
# out-of-tree platform plugin — may import it.
sngl check ok.sngl
stdout 'ok'

! sngl check internal.sngl
stderr 'internal to the compiler'

! sngl check nosuch.sngl
stderr 'unknown stdlib package'

-- ok.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:macro"
import app "sngl:app"

#[options]
struct Knobs {
    gadget string = ""
}

component main ui {
    text(value="hello")
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- internal.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:internal/marks"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
    text(value="hello")
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- nosuch.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:nosuch"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
    text(value="hello")
}

app.window {
    main
}
